title: Types of Mechanical Energy
text: Kinetic energy (Ek = ½mv²) is energy of motion. Gravitational potential energy (Ep = mgh) is energy due to position above a reference point.

title: Conservation Principle
text: Without air resistance, no energy is lost. Potential energy converts to kinetic energy as the ball falls, but total mechanical energy stays the same.

title: The Equation
text: At any two points: ½mv₁² + mgh₁ = ½mv₂² + mgh₂. Notice that mass m cancels out!
